metadata.source: PGIMER Patient Help Guide (November 2026) & PGI Saathi SRS v1.0
metadata.disclaimer: Independent patient guide seed data. Not an official PGIMER publication. Hospital-specific room numbers, counters, and schedules must be reconfirmed on-site.

buildings.name: New OPD Block
buildings.description: Main outpatient facility housing general registration counters and majority of specialty clinics.

buildings.name: Advanced Cardiac Centre (ACC)
buildings.description: Dedicated cardiology and cardiothoracic surgery building. Do not search for cardiac clinics inside New OPD.

buildings.name: Advanced Paediatric Centre (APC)
buildings.description: Dedicated specialty hospital for children and infant medical care.
buildings.landmark: Separate building next to Advanced Eye Centre

buildings.name: Advanced Eye Centre (AEC)
buildings.description: Dedicated ophthalmology hospital for eye conditions, surgery, and vision care.

buildings.name: Advanced Trauma Centre (ATC)
buildings.description: 24/7 dedicated acute emergency trauma care facility for accidents, major injuries, and acute critical trauma.

buildings.name: Nehru Hospital / Emergency Block
buildings.description: Main indoor wards, 24/7 medical and surgical emergency triage.

departments.name: Internal Medicine / General Medicine
departments.notes: Primary starting point for adults without an established sub-specialty diagnosis.

weekdays.notes: Registration counters close sharply. Special clinics have separate schedules.

saturday_and_holidays.notes: Closed on Sundays. Emergency remains open 24/7.

sample_collection.verification_warning: Reference location from published guide. Always check the exact room stamped on your doctor's test slip.
sample_collection.fasting_guidance: Fasting is NOT required for every blood test. Do not stop prescribed medications unless specifically advised by your doctor.

sample_collection.verification_warning: Intended specifically for drug monitoring samples, not routine blood counts.

sample_collection.verification_warning: Counter depends on the specific sample. Ask the lab help desk near Room 127 or check the slip.
Ultrasound, CT, and MRI usually require scheduling and appointment token.

emergency_warning_signs: Severe central chest pain, pressure, or radiating pain to jaw/arm
Extreme shortness of breath or sudden inability to breathe
Loss of consciousness, sudden fainting, or unresponsiveness
Sudden weakness, paralysis of one side of face/body, or slurred speech (Stroke alert)
Severe uncontrolled bleeding, major burns, or acute road accident injuries
Continuous seizures or lack of consciousness following a seizure
emergency_instruction: DO NOT WAIT IN THE ROUTINE OPD REGISTRATION QUEUE. Proceed immediately to Emergency / Nehru Hospital or Advanced Trauma Centre (ATC).
